name: pilzno-crm
description: Pilzno Synagogue CRM — monorepo (api + web + shared)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pilzno/api" "npm run dev -w @pilzno/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pilzno/api && npm run build -w @pilzno/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pilzno/api && npm run typecheck -w @pilzno/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @pilzno/api && npm run lint -w @pilzno/web
